page.title: SIM Profiles
page.description: APN and TTL per SIM card, applied by themselves when the active SIM changes: a swapped card, a slot switch, a watchdog failover.

not_installed.title: SIM profiles are not installed on the modem
not_installed.description: The web UI is newer than the system scripts: run ./install.sh without --onlywww to add sim-profiles and its timer. Profiles can be edited meanwhile, but nothing applies them.

active.title: Active SIM
active.description: The SIM in use now and the settings the modem runs with.

last_apply.title: Last Apply
last_apply.description: A new SIM gets its profile at the second check, about 30 seconds after it shows up; a watchdog switch applies it at once.
last_apply.empty_title: No profile applied since the last reboot
last_apply.empty_description: Create a profile for each SIM; it applies when that SIM becomes the active one.

list.title: Profiles
list.description: One per SIM, keyed by ICCID and kept in /data/simpleadmin/sim-profiles across updates.
list.empty_description: Start from the active SIM with Create from Current Settings, or add one for another SIM by its ICCID.

delete_dialog.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete_dialog.description: The modem keeps its current APN and TTL; the SIM simply gets no profile the next time it becomes active.

apply_dialog.title: Apply “{{name}}” now?
apply_dialog.other_sim: This profile belongs to another SIM ({{profile}}): its settings go to the active one ({{active}}).
apply_dialog.description: When the APN changes, the radio restarts to attach with it and the connection drops for 10 to 20 seconds. The TTL changes at once.

form.description: Applied by itself whenever this SIM becomes the active one. Empty fields leave that setting as it is.
form.name: Name
form.iccid_hint: The SIM this profile belongs to.
form.ttl_hint: Outgoing TTL and IPv6 hop limit; 0 turns the override off.

errors.name: 1 to 32 letters, digits, spaces and . _ ( ) + -
errors.iccid: 18 to 22 digits, as the SIM reports it
errors.apn: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore, at most 63
errors.form: Set an APN, a TTL, or both.

progress.title: Applying Profile
progress.radio_restarting: The radio is restarting to attach with the new APN.
progress.radio_restarting_hint: The connection drops for about 10 to 20 seconds; this page reconnects by itself.

errors.read_failed: Unable to read the SIM profiles
